listening.title: Listening
listening.description: You will hear audio clips and answer multiple-choice questions. Audio plays once automatically.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: Read passages and answer multiple-choice questions.

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Complete two written tasks. Watch your word count (150–200 words each).
writing.practiceDescription: Complete each writing task. Watch your word count (150–200 words each).

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.description: Record spoken responses for 8 tasks. You will have preparation time before each task.
speaking.practiceDescription: Record a spoken response for each task. You will have preparation time before each one.

listeningAudioOnce: Audio plays once only — listen carefully.
listeningAudioComplete: Audio complete. Answer the questions below.

0.name: Problem Solving
0.instruction: Listen to a conversation about solving a problem. You will hear it once.

1.name: Daily Life Conversation
1.instruction: Listen to an everyday conversation. You will hear it once.

2.name: Listening for Information
2.instruction: Listen as someone gives information. You will hear it once.

3.name: News Item
3.instruction: Listen to a news report. You will hear it once.

4.name: Discussion
4.instruction: Listen to a discussion among several speakers. You will hear it once.

5.name: Viewpoints
5.instruction: Listen to a person share different viewpoints. You will hear it once.
